_about: ID7 Corsa (M View of the BMW M cluster, photo 2): reference = BMW M GmbH's press photo of the M8 Competition cluster (05/2019, 5758x3838, frontal), placed on the display at 0.3104 px per photo px + (39.1, -312.7) (cluster/design/refs/id7/Corsa.png, not in git). Each element traced automatically on the 4x enlargement (cluster/tools/trace_id7.py). Coordinates normalized on the 1920x720 grid.

fuel._about: The fuel gauge, bottom left. Reference: BMW M GmbH's own press photo of the M8 cluster (05/2019, 5758x3838, frontal), placed on the display by the bottom text row of the user's G31 (range icon and outside temperature: 0.3104 display px per photo px), lines measured row by row / column by column at 4x (cluster/design/refs/id7/M8_fuel_x4.png, not in git). A: the thin outer line (1.3 px), B: the thick line (3.1 px) up to its corner at the '1', where it turns into a wedge that fades towards the label, with a short barb up-left; B ends at x 302.6 just before the reserve. C: the lit edge of the fill (the '0' line at the bottom), live. Stubs at 1/4 and 3/4 on B's inner side, the 1/2 tick across the dark track (live, under the level). Reserve: red bar continuing B's line, a step up at x 328 and a rising, fading upper part.

top._about: the '1': B turns at its corner into a white wedge that narrows and greys out towards the label; a short barb goes up-left from it

levels._about: where each level meets C (its y on C), the slope of its line, and the C points used for level 0 / for the arc

fill._about: lit from C: brightness by the distance to C (px), measured on row y 480; wider towards the bottom (scale by y)

reserve._about: lower bar on B's line (x 304-328), the step up, and the upper part rising and fading to x 348

shade._about: thin darker wedge on the lower bar's top face

reserve._layers: the reserve mark vectorized on the 10x enlargement of the photo (M8_fuel_x10.png, display grid x 10 from x 190, y 400): red-channel layers (red over green/blue by 25+) at levels 40..235, each painted flat in its median colour, lowest first: the bright front edges, the darker top face and its shading come out as on the photo

revs._about: The two blades of the rev counter (0-8 x1000/min), traced on the 4x enlargement: O the white outer line (centre, width by y) with its thin end over the '8' (O_top: x, y, brightness), ticks (white wedge from O + the dark slit cutting O), E the lit edge and I the thin inner line (peaks by y), the body's light (base RGB by y, glow by distance from E / I), the rev zones along O's inner edge (y range, offsets from O's inner edge), the even numbers (boxes). values_y: the y of each tick (0..8) for the live fill. fill: the live bar (as photographed at idle): red bar, grey block under it, red glow above it (rows above the bar x 6 stops E -> I). The right blade is traced on the photo mirrored about x 960 and mapped back.

center._about: Component 2, the centre: the gear (P as photographed, traced outline + counter), the speed (0 traced) with km/h, the horizontal line (end pieces: two slanted stripes and a white bar each side, the grey line between), traced sub-row by sub-row at 4x (trace_id7.py center). Other gears / speeds: BMW's big squared glyphs (gen_static.big_glyph) with the strokes measured on the P and the 0 (style, display px), centred on the traced glyph's centre.

temp._about: Component 3, the temperature gauge right (oil 50-100-150 °C): the fuel gauge's mirror (photo: outer lines symmetric about x 952.5 on rows 430-510), so its lines are stored in the mirrored frame (x' = 2 * 952.5 - x) and drawn by the fuel gauge's code, then mirrored; its own colours, zones and labels traced on the photo. Labels are in display coordinates.

top._about: the '1': B turns at its corner into a white wedge that narrows and greys out towards the label; a short barb goes up-left from it

levels._about: where each level meets C (its y on C), the slope of its line, and the C points used for level 0 / for the arc

fill._about: lit from C: brightness by the distance to C (px), measured on row y 480; wider towards the bottom (scale by y) Temp: the lit band keeps its width towards the bottom and dims there (gain_y), fitted on the photo rows 515-566 (mean error 49 -> 34 grey levels).

reserve._about: the cold mark (blue), the fuel's reserve mark mirrored

shade._about: thin darker wedge on the lower bar's top face

B_zone._about: B red from its top corner down to y 445 (the hot zone), measured on the photo
